about.description: Anzen provides tokenized access to private credit and structured finance products, connecting institutional lenders with decentralized liquidity. It enables securitization of off-chain credit through on-chain smart contracts.
about.registryInfo: Anzen Finance is a US private-credit RWA platform issuing USDz, a yield-bearing stablecoin backed by short-duration private-credit pools. Founded 2023, US-domiciled; partners with Securitize for compliance and Percent Lab for credit origination.

fees.revenueNotes: Anzen earns the spread between gross private-credit yields (~10-15% gross) and the sUSDz pass-through rate (~6-8%) net of credit reserves and origination fees.
